So whe"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"n the agent writes a README, renders a chart, or captures a screenshot, the image stays on disk and "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"`![](./out.png)` becomes a dead link the moment you push. This plugin closes that gap."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"It uploads through **whatever image host you already configured in PicGo** — PicGo Cloud, GitHub, S3"},{"id":"p5s2","text":", Tencent COS, Qiniu, or any third-party uploader plugin you installed. Nothing to re-configure. If "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"you've never used PicGo, it walks you into PicGo Cloud's free tier."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"If the **PicGo desktop app** is running, uploads go through it, reusing the image host you set up in"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" its window. Otherwise they run in-process. | `/picgo <path>...` | Upload one or more files |
| `/picg"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"o status` | Show the active host and sign-in state |
| `/picgo login [token]` | Sign in to PicGo Clo"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ud |
| `/picgo logout` | Sign out |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"**A bundled skill** that teaches the model *when* to upload — inserting a screenshot into docs is th"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"e primary case — and when not to (you named a specific destination, you want a local copy)."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Upload routes"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"There are two ways this plugin can reach your image host, and it picks one per upload:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"1. **The PicGo desktop app**, when it is running. It exposes a local upload server, and using it mea"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ns your uploads honour the host you configured in the app's window.
2. **In-process PicGo**, otherwi"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"se — the `picgo` library reading `~/.picgo/config.json`."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"This matters because **the two read different config files**. The desktop app stores its settings in"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" the system application-data directory (on macOS `~/Library/Application Support/picgo/data.json`), w"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"hile the library reads `~/.picgo/config.json`. If you have only ever used the GUI, the library route"},{"id":"p21s4","text":" sees a config you never touched — most likely empty and defaulting to PicGo Cloud. Preferring the a"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"pp is what makes "it just uses my existing setup" true."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"> **Upgrading from 0.1.x?** If the desktop app is running *and* the two configs point at different h"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"osts, your uploads will now land on the app's host rather than the CLI's. Set `gui.mode: off` to kee"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"p the old behaviour."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"`/picgo status` tells you which route is active. Two things worth knowing about the desktop-app rout"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"picgo status` tells you which route is active. Two things worth knowing about the desktop-app route:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- The app **copies each URL to your clipboard and shows a notification** — that is the app's own beh"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"aviour and this plugin cannot turn it off.
- If an upload there fails with a login error, sign in **"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"from the app's own window**. `/picgo login` writes the PicGo CLI config, which the desktop app does "},{"id":"p24s4","text":"app's own window**. `/picgo login` writes the PicGo CLI config, which the desktop app does not read."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## First run"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"If you've never configured PicGo, uploads default to **PicGo Cloud**, which needs a one-time sign-in"},{"id":"p26s2","text":". If you already have a token from the Pic"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"Go Cloud dashboard, `/picgo login <token>` is instant."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The model will never run this for you: with no token the sign-in blocks waiting on a browser callbac"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"k, which would hang the session. | `silent` | `true` | Suppress PicGo's console output and its `picgo.log` writes |
| `timeoutMs` | "},{"id":"p35s3","text":"`120000` | How long to wait for one upload |
| `registerSkill` | `true` | Register the bundled `picg"},{"id":"p35s4","text":"o-upload` skill |
| `registerCommand` | `true` | Register the `/picgo` command |
| `announceSignIn` "},{"id":"p35s5","text":"| `true` | On startup, point a signed-out PicGo Cloud user at `/picgo login` |
| `gui` | see below |"},{"id":"p35s6","text":" How to reach a running PicGo desktop app |"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"`gui` controls the desktop-app route described in Upload routes:"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"| Field | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"| `gui.mode` | `auto` | `auto` uses the app when it answers; `off` never tries; `only` requires it r"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"ather than uploading to a different host |
| `gui.host` | `127.0.0.1` | Where the app's upload serve"},{"id":"p38s3","text":"r listens |
| `gui.port` | `36677` | " |
| `gui.secret` | `''` | Auth secret, if you enabled one in "},{"id":"p38s4","text":"the app. Empty falls back to `$PICGO_SERVER_SECRET` |
| `gui.probeTimeoutMs` | `1500` | How long to "},{"id":"p38s5","text":"wait for the app to answer a heartbeat |
| `gui.probeTtlMs` | `5000` | How long a heartbeat result i"},{"id":"p38s6","text":"s reused, so a multi-file upload does not re-probe per file |
| `gui.timeoutMs` | `0` | Upload deadl"},{"id":"p38s7","text":"ine for this route; `0` inherits `timeoutMs` |"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"A patch replaces a row's **entire** `config` rather than merging keys, so restate every field you wa"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"nt to keep.
